header.label: OpenAEC Foundation
header.title: Services
header.desc: The OpenAEC Foundation provides professional services around the open source ecosystem.

ecosystem.title: The OpenAEC Ecosystem as a service
ecosystem.desc: All tools available in one integrated ecosystem. Redundantly set up, with Single Sign-On (SSO) and local AI as orchestrator for controlling all tools. One platform, one login, maximum productivity.

consultancy.title: Consultancy
consultancy.desc: Advice on implementation, integration and optimization of OpenAEC tools within your organization. From strategic advice to hands-on implementation guidance.

hosting.title: Hosting & SLA
hosting.desc: Managed hosting of all tools in the ecosystem with guaranteed uptime and professional support. We handle the infrastructure, you use the tools.

extensions.title: Extensions & custom development
extensions.desc: We develop extensions on the software for specific client requirements. The base remains open source — the extension becomes property of the client or is contributed to the ecosystem.

donations.title: Donations
donations.desc: Support the development of open source software for the AEC industry. Every contribution helps us develop the ecosystem faster and make it available.

subsidies.title: Grants
subsidies.desc: We actively work on obtaining government grants for innovation and digitalization in construction. Together with our partners we focus on sustainable funding.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Build your package
pricing.intro: Enter the number of licences per tool and see your monthly price instantly. Includes professional support (SLA) during NL business hours plus a direct AI integration (MCP servers, copilots) on the tool. Software stays 100% open source — you only pay for the service.
pricing.footnote: All prices are per user per month, excluding VAT. Cherry-pick only the tools you need, or combine them into one integrated workspace.

totals.hint: All amounts are indicative. Monthly amounts are billed per user per month; implementation is a one-off charge per consultant per day.

pricing.cta: Would you like a tailored offer for your organisation?

partner.label: Partnership
partner.title: Become a partner of the OpenAEC Foundation
partner.intro: Like the Blender Foundation, OpenAEC runs on structural support from companies that believe in open source for construction. Partners fund development, gain influence over the roadmap and become visible as a driving force behind an open AEC chain. Annual contributions from € 5,000 to € 100,000.
